passages.text: Now these are the portions that the Israelites inherited in the land of Canaan, as distributed by Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the tribes of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites received land in Canaan.
Eleazar was the priest.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
The heads of the families led each tribe of Israel.
Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of the tribes gave out the land.
They divided the land among the Israelites.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ נָחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִֽחֲל֜וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave a command through Moses.
Moses led the people of Israel.
There were nine and a half tribes of Israel.
The people divided the land of Canaan.
They used lots to assign the land.
Each of the nine and a half tribes received an inheritance by lot.
They did this as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
passages.original: בְּגוֹרַ֖ל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For Moses had given the inheritance east of the Jordan to the other two and a half tribes. But he granted no inheritance among them to the Levites.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses gave land as an inheritance.
He gave this land to two and a half tribes of Israel.
This land was east of the Jordan River.
Moses did not give any land as an inheritance to the Levites.
The Levites did not receive a share of the land among the other tribes.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ נָתַ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה נַחֲלַ֨ת שְׁנֵ֤י הַמַּטּוֹת֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֔ה מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְלַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא־ נָתַ֥ן נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

passages.text: The descendants of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion of the land was given to the Levites, except for cities in which to live, along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
passages.sermon:
Joseph had descendants.
His descendants became two tribes.
The two tribes were Manasseh and Ephraim.
The Levites did not receive a portion of the land.
The Levites received cities to live in.
The Levites also received pasturelands.
The Levites used the pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הָי֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יוֹסֵ֛ף שְׁנֵ֥י מַטּ֖וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־ נָתְנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק לַלְוִיִּ֜ם בָּאָ֗רֶץ כִּ֤י אִם־ עָרִים֙ לָשֶׁ֔בֶת וּמִ֨גְרְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם לְמִקְנֵיהֶ֖ם וּלְקִנְיָנָֽם׃

passages.text: So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave commands to Moses.
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The Israelites obeyed the LORD’s commands.
They did what the LORD told Moses.
The Israelites divided the land.
passages.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיַּחְלְק֖וּ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

passages.text: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Judah came to Joshua.
They met him at Gilgal.
Caleb was with them.
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.
Caleb was a Kenizzite.
Caleb spoke to Joshua.
Caleb said, “You know what the LORD said.
The LORD spoke to Moses.
Moses was the man of God.
The LORD spoke at Kadesh-barnea.
The LORD spoke about you and me.”
passages.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ בַּגִּלְגָּ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו כָּלֵ֥ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֖ה הַקְּנִזִּ֑י אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֡עְתָּ אֶֽת־ הַדָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים עַ֧ל אֹדוֹתַ֛י וְעַ֥ל אֹדוֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּקָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back to him an honest report.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was forty years old at that time.
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses sent Caleb from Kadesh-barnea.
Moses told Caleb to spy out the land.
Caleb went and explored the land.
Caleb brought back a report to Moses.
Caleb spoke what was in his heart.
Caleb gave an honest report.
passages.original: בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אָנֹכִ֗י בִּ֠שְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לְרַגֵּ֣ל אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וָאָשֵׁ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר עִם־ לְבָבִֽי׃

passages.text: Although my brothers who went with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear, I remained loyal to the LORD my God.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.  
Caleb was a Kenizzite.  
Caleb went to spy out the land with his brothers.  
His brothers went up with him.  
His brothers caused the people to lose courage.  
His brothers made the hearts of the people melt with fear.  
Caleb stayed faithful to the LORD his God.  
Caleb remained loyal to the LORD his God.
passages.original: וְאַחַי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָל֣וּ עִמִּ֔י הִמְסִ֖יו אֶת־ לֵ֣ב הָעָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתִי אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: On that day Moses swore to me, saying, ‘Surely the land on which you have set foot will be an inheritance to you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’
passages.sermon:
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
On that day, Moses made a promise to me.
Moses swore an oath.
He said these words to me.
The land where you have walked will belong to you.
This land will also belong to your children forever.
You will receive this inheritance.
You have completely followed the LORD my God.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־ לֹ֗א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דָּרְכָ֤ה רַגְלְךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ לְךָ֨ תִֽהְיֶ֧ה לְנַחֲלָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתָ אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: Now behold, as the LORD promised, He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old, still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. As my strength was then, so it is now for war, for going out, and for coming in.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was a faithful servant of the LORD, the God of Israel.
The LORD promised to keep Caleb alive.
The LORD has kept Caleb alive for forty-five years.
The LORD spoke this promise to Moses forty-five years ago.
Israel wandered in the wilderness during these years.
Today, Caleb is eighty-five years old.
Caleb is still strong today.
Caleb is as strong now as he was when Moses sent him out.
Caleb’s strength now is the same as it was then.
Caleb is strong for war.
Caleb is strong for going out.
Caleb is strong for coming in.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּה֩ הֶחֱיָ֨ה יְהוָ֣ה׀ אוֹתִי֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּר֒ זֶה֩ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנָ֗ה מֵ֠אָז דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֥ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְעַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם בֶּן־ חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃ עוֹדֶ֨נִּי הַיּ֜וֹם חָזָ֗ק כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ בְּי֨וֹם שְׁלֹ֤חַ אוֹתִי֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֥חִי אָ֖ז וּכְכֹ֣חִי עָ֑תָּה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלָצֵ֥את וְלָבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities. Perhaps with the LORD’s help I will drive them out, as the LORD has spoken.”
passages.sermon:
Caleb son of Jephunneh spoke to Joshua.
Caleb was a faithful servant of the LORD, the God of Israel.
Caleb said, “Now give me this hill country.
The LORD promised this land to me on that day.
You heard on that day that the Anakim were there.
The Anakim are a people of great size.
There are great and fortified cities in that land.
Perhaps the LORD will be with me.
If the LORD helps me, I will drive out the Anakim.
I will take the land, just as the LORD said.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנָה־ לִּי֙ אֶת־ הָהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא כִּ֣י אַתָּֽה־ שָׁמַעְתָּ֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא כִּֽי־ עֲנָקִ֣ים שָׁ֗ם וְעָרִים֙ גְּדֹל֣וֹת בְּצֻר֔וֹת אוּלַ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתִי֙ וְה֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua blessed Caleb.
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.
Joshua gave Hebron to Caleb.
Hebron became Caleb’s inheritance.
passages.original: וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־ חֶבְר֛וֹן לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֖ה לְנַחֲלָֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore Hebron belongs to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an inheritance to this day, because he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.
Caleb was a Kenizzite.
Hebron belongs to Caleb.
Hebron is Caleb’s inheritance.
Caleb has this inheritance to this day.
Caleb received Hebron because he wholly followed the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֣ן הָיְתָֽה־ חֶ֠בְרוֹן לְכָלֵ֨ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֤ה הַקְּנִזִּי֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִלֵּ֔א אַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.) Then the land had rest from war.
passages.sermon:
Hebron is a city in the land of Israel.
People once called Hebron by another name.
They called it Kiriath-arba.
Arba was a man from the Anakim.
Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim.
The Anakim were a people known for their size and strength.
After these events, the land became peaceful.
The land had rest from war.
passages.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם חֶבְר֤וֹן לְפָנִים֙ קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע הָאָדָ֧ם הַגָּד֛וֹל בָּעֲנָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְהָאָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה׃פ
